text:
andrew: heads up, rack5 started showing a cluster of pcie resets + ECC correctable bursts since last night.
mona: saw it on the dashboards, spike at ~02:10UTC. Jobs started getting random CUDA OOMs then XID 45s.
liam: sample syslog snippet:
```[2025-03-11T02:12:09Z] kernel: pcie link down GPU3 slot4
[2025-03-11T02:12:09Z] nvlink: XID 45 at 0x7f1e...
[2025-03-11T02:12:10Z] nvidia: ECC correctable 0x03 on GPU3
```
elaine: any common hardware between failing cards? vendor, lot, or PSU?
andrew: looked up serials: SN-B210, SN-B211, SN-B217 — all from vendor lot C-91, same shipping batch. Power supply on that chassis is a dual-rails MPN-PSU-900.
mona: telemetry shows short power dips ~200ms correlated with the errors. PSU outputs fluctuate by ~6-8% during high transient loads.
ops-bot: ALERT: rack5 capacity -3 GPUs (drain) at 1843605000 by andrew
liam: vendor called back: "we've seen capacitor ESR drift on C-91 at high ambient temp cycles" — they requested capacitor part numbers for crosscheck.
vendor-support: opened vendor case VS-9901, advised to capture oscilloscope traces during a replication.
andrew: quick repro: launch 64-worker CUDA matrix-mul loop for 45min -> reproduce power dip + pcie retrain on affected nodes.
elaine: short-term: propose apply power cap -12% + staggered job starts to reduce inrush currents. Also bump fan curves to keep ambient down.
mona: perf impact estimates: -12% power cap => ~8-11% throughput loss on those cards.
liam: long-term: schedule PSU replacement for that chassis and stop using lot C-91 for now. Procurement: place hold on lot C-91 and require ESR spec confirmation.
andrew: will collect oscilloscope traces tonight during load test and upload to VS-9901 and internal GH-2308.
ops-bot: ACTION: applied powercap -12% to GPUs [SN-B210,SN-B211,SN-B217] at 1843605200 (by andrew)
mona: after powercap, no new XIDs in 6h, voltage variance reduced to ~1.2%.
liam: RCA draft: root cause = capacitor ESR degradation in vendor lot C-91 causing PSU transient instability under load -> PCIe retrains and ECC spikes -> job evictions. Contributing: high ambient in rack due to airflow constraint.
elaine: remediation: RMA for affected PSUs, procurement hold, add runtime rule: if pcie retrain rate > 0.5/hr then auto-drain node, add oscilloscope-based acceptance test for new lots.
andrew: customer impact: 3 GPUs out of us-west pool (~2% capacity) + 4 interrupted jobs overnight.
mona: assigning owners: andrew -> traces + GH-2308, liam -> procurement hold + vendor followup, elaine -> alerting rule + runbook update.
ops-bot: THREAD CLOSED BY andrew at 1843608050
